steps.summary: Demonstration course for the PDF Export block. Curso de demostración: los acentos y la eñe se exportan correctamente.

steps.name: Welcome / Bienvenida
steps.content:
Welcome

This page is exported with its formatting, tables and images.

Course plan
WeekTopic
1Introducción y bienvenida
2Recursos de aprendizaje
What is included in the PDF?

Pages, books, text and media areas, images stored in Moodle, and links to everything else.

Bienvenida

Esta página se exporta con su formato, tablas e imágenes.

steps.name: Introduction book
steps.intro: A book with chapters and a subchapter.

steps.comment: Book chapters: there is no blueprint step for them.
steps.code:
define('CLI_SCRIPT', true); foreach (['/www/moodle/config.php', getcwd() . '/config.php'] as $c) { if (is_file($c)) { require_once($c); break; } } global $DB, $CFG; $course = $DB->get_record('course', ['shortname' => 'PDFDEMO'], '*', MUST_EXIST); $book = $DB->get_record('book', ['course' => $course->id, 'name' => 'Introduction book'], '*', MUST_EXIST); if (!$DB->record_exists('book_chapters', ['bookid' => $book->id])) { $chapters = [['Chapter 1: Getting started', 0, 0, '

Read the welcome page first, then explore each section.

  • Pages and books are printed in full.
  • Files, folders and links are listed.
'], ['Navigating the course', 1, 0, '

Use the course index to move between sections.

'], ['Chapter 2: Capítulo en español', 0, 0, '

El PDF conserva las tildes, la eñe y la estructura de capítulos y subcapítulos.

'], ['Teacher notes (hidden chapter)', 0, 1, '

Students never see this hidden chapter.

']]; foreach ($chapters as $i => [$title, $sub, $hidden, $content]) { $DB->insert_record('book_chapters', (object)['bookid' => $book->id, 'pagenum' => $i + 1, 'subchapter' => $sub, 'title' => $title, 'content' => $content, 'contentformat' => FORMAT_HTML, 'hidden' => $hidden, 'timecreated' => time(), 'timemodified' => time(), 'importsrc' => '']); } rebuild_course_cache($course->id, true); }

steps.comment: Add the PDF Export block to the course and publish every exportable resource.
steps.code: define('CLI_SCRIPT', true); foreach (['/www/moodle/config.php', getcwd() . '/config.php'] as $c) { if (is_file($c)) { require_once($c); break; } } global $DB, $CFG; $course = $DB->get_record('course', ['shortname' => 'PDFDEMO'], '*', MUST_EXIST); $context = context_course::instance($course->id); if (!$DB->record_exists('block_instances', ['blockname' => 'pdfexport', 'parentcontextid' => $context->id])) { $page = new moodle_page(); $page->set_course($course); $page->set_pagetype('course-view-' . $course->format); $page->blocks->add_region('side-pre'); $page->blocks->add_block('pdfexport', 'side-pre', -10, false, 'course-view-*'); } $record = $DB->get_record('block_instances', ['blockname' => 'pdfexport', 'parentcontextid' => $context->id], '*', MUST_EXIST); $cmids = []; foreach (get_fast_modinfo($course)->get_cms() as $cm) { if ($cm->modname !== 'quiz') { $cmids[] = $cm->id; } } \block_pdfexport\local\publication::save(block_instance('pdfexport', $record), $cmids);
